314057dfee2f8380.name: wait_for_motion
314057dfee2f8380.doc: Waits until the current motion reaches its last frame.

3908c03da35438c3.doc: Reels back from a staggering hit and waits until the reaction ends.

84082490ee64fc16.doc: Each frame: swipe at a target in reach, turn toward one that is near, or wander.

851d53055c960e6b.name: wander
851d53055c960e6b.doc: Walks toward a random point near home until it arrives, the target comes close or three seconds pass.

d98d1bb90836d9d8.doc: Makes the spot where the monster was placed its home and gives its swipe a hit.
